_meta.source: Wattlyst Pakistan Electricity Bill Index: every bill is computed by the Wattlyst bill engine from data/tariff-pk-2026.json (NEPRA SRO 279(I)/2026 A-1 domestic rates, uniform for ex-WAPDA DISCOs and K-Electric) plus the month's fuel price adjustment and quarterly adjustment below
_meta.method: For each billing month and units level: energy charge (protected: slab-wise; unprotected: all units at the rate of the slab reached) + fixed charge for the sanctioned load below + FC surcharge + QTA for the quarter + FPA for the month (not charged to protected consumers) + GST on the subtotal. Change = this month minus last month. One sanctioned load for every row so months compare like for like.
_meta.status: Add one month at the top at each monthly refresh (FPA notified by NEPRA for the month two months earlier). Keep old months: they are the index history.
